steps.text: An article is extracted: its Browser call is priced by browser time
Auto-tag runs with the fixture Jev, which has no rate
A page whose Browser call hangs is cancelled from Activity while the call runs
Activity shows a cost and nothing about unknown costs
Settings > Usage shows each feature's cost and never 'unpriced'

checks.name: API: Autotag +1 run, counted as unpriced in the API only
API: the hanging page has a Browser call in flight
Exactly one batch is still running
API: the cancelled call is failed, interrupted, and priced
API: Content has no unpriced calls, and its cost grew by the priced and the estimated call
Activity header shows a dollar total
Activity never says unpriced, costs unknown or known subtotal
Content row shows a cost that is not $0.00
Autotag row shows a dash, not 'unpriced'
